parsed.rationale: Both participating records — `Playcut.stub` in `_Plant_PlaycutStub.swift` and `Talkset.stub` in `PlaylistStubs.swift` — carry `is_test: true` and reside in the `PlaylistTesting` source group of the `Playlist` package. Stub factory methods are intentionally per-type fixtures; even if their structural shape is similar (Jaccard 0.71), each stub constructs a distinct domain model (`Playcut` vs. `Talkset`) and collapsing them into a single generic function would obscure intent and couple unrelated test helpers. The `fields_or_signature` arrays are both empty, so there is insufficient evidence to determine a safe generic signature without hallucinating details.
